build_DETRHead: build a DETRHead instance with num_classes and embed_dims for end-to-end object detection
forward_DETRHead: run the DETRHead forward pass on transformer decoder hidden states to get cls scores and bbox preds
loss_DETRHead: compute classification, bbox L1, and GIoU losses for DETRHead using Hungarian assigner matching
predict_DETRHead: predict object detection results from transformer decoder outputs using DETRHead with rescaling
get_targets_DETRHead: compute classification and regression targets for DETRHead using HungarianAssigner bipartite matching
